enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Mother Night's Embrace: This weapon is unholy and imbued by one of the two deities of Barovia - the Mother Night. This weapon is evil, dealing an additional 3d6 evil damage on hit.
Human Bane 3: This weapon is attuned specifically to hunt those with diversity and ambition, dealing an additional 3d10 bane damage vs. Humans.
Vampirism 1: This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +1d2 hit points with each hit.Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.
Chilling 3: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 3d6 Ice damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
